attempt: Resize the legacy masked-quad RGBA atlas to quarter scale separately from the individual face patches and UV coordinates.
reason_failed: Independent rounding at the reduced scale misaligned transparency masks with some face patches, producing enlarged/disconnected visual fragments on diagonals in user screenshots.
environment: Hytale 0.6.8 client; Adaptive Surface legacy fallback through 0.9.0
error_signature: Visible diagonal seams and exposed triangular fragments in fallback stone surfaces
conditions: Triangle geometry represented by alpha-masked quads
workaround: Use full native-resolution PreloadedHD models and byte-identical native RGBA textures for fallback states while retaining saved block IDs.

source_refs.description: Fallback texture replacement and byte comparison
